), captions AS (

WITH routes AS (
  SELECT a.station_id AS first_station, b.station_id AS second_station, d.drive_min + a.unload_min AS first_finish, a.latest_min AS first_deadline, leg.drive_min + b.unload_min AS second_duration, b.latest_min AS second_deadline, a.source_id AS first_source, b.source_id AS second_source
  FROM handoff_note AS a
  JOIN handoff_note AS b ON b.station_id <> a.station_id
  JOIN drive_leg AS d ON d.origin_id = 'BASE' AND d.dest_id = a.station_id
  JOIN drive_leg AS leg ON leg.origin_id = a.station_id AND leg.dest_id = b.station_id
)
SELECT first_station, second_station, first_finish + second_duration AS finish_min, first_source, second_source
FROM routes
WHERE first_finish <= first_deadline AND first_finish + second_duration <= second_deadline
ORDER BY finish_min, first_station COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1
